title: Syntax suffix recognition
statement: For a state $q\in\{0,1,2,3,4,5\}$ and a finite bit string $x$, the following condition holds exactly when processing $x$ from state $q$ by the transitions specified below ends in state $4$: at state $0$, $x$ is the encoding of a CNF formula; at state $1$, it is the encoding of a clause followed by the encoding of a CNF formula; at state $2$, it has the form $1^v0b$ followed by the encoding of a clause and the encoding of a CNF formula, for some $v\in\mathbb N$ and bit $b$; at state $3$, it is a bit followed by the encoding of a clause and the encoding of a CNF formula; at state $4$, $x$ is empty; and at state $5$, the condition is false. On input $1$, states $0,1,2,3$ move respectively to $1,2,2,1$, while on input $0$ they move respectively to $4,0,3,1$; from either state $4$ or state $5$, either input moves to state $5$.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is one of the six states $0,1,2,3,4,5$
